CA.rationale: Content (red) for a candidate node is explicitly linked to a processing-origin (command_estimate).

COD.rationale: Content (red/blue) entries for a current node are given alongside an explicit origin/status entry, supplying content, organization/access and a separate status indicator.

A.rationale: A processing condition (command_estimate / feedback_through) is explicitly attached to the candidate content entry, linking processing/origin to that content's representation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly enumerate represented content items (coordinates) with color attributes.

D.rationale: Origins/status metadata are provided separately from the coordinate content listings, distinguishing content identification from status/organization/origin.

O.rationale: The report states how coordinates map to rows/columns (display property) and gives explicit origin/representation metadata describing how contents are organized/accessed.
